title: App icons / Sizing specifications

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Sizing specifications

slide_intent: Scale an icon’s construction with its overall size, because enlarging the boundary alone would change weight, padding and perceived balance.
strategic_value: A coordinated size table can keep IBM app icons consistent from compact interface controls to expressive applications.
demonstration: An eight-row table pairs icon sizes 16–96px with stroke width, padding, live area and corner radius; a short instruction appears beneath.
practical_value: Look up all construction values together when moving an icon to an approved size.

content_islands.name: Sizing tab
content_islands.spec: Show Sizing specifications selected beside Icon sizes.

content_islands.name: Construction table
content_islands.spec: Align icon size, stroke width, padding, live area and corner radius in five columns.

content_islands.name: Usage instruction
content_islands.spec: Place the note about original sizes and accepted increments below the table.

ingredient.name: App-icon size relationships
ingredient.role: Preserve weight and interior space while changing scale.
ingredient.application: Use the table’s corresponding stroke, padding, live-area and radius values for each approved size.
ingredient.scope: App-icon usage guidance. Core productive sizes are 16, 20, 24 and 32px; expressive applications may use 48px and above.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying sizing text connects the core sizes to clarity and consistency in functional contexts.
reference_purposes.Application: The table links each icon size to its corresponding construction values, such as 32px with 2px stroke/padding/radius and 28px live area.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source directs original sizes or accepted increments;16, 20, 24 and 32px are the core product sizes, while expressive uses may start at 48px.
